verdict.rationale: The evidence documents markdown, HTML, structured JSON and 'LLM-ready output', but nothing shows Firecrawl itself offering semantically chunked output for retrieval pipelines. Schema-based JSON extraction is a related feature, not chunking, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can request semantically chunked output instead of one large content blob, so it feeds cleanly into a retrieval pipeline
